reproduced_claims.observation: A cold public start and checkpoint-resume public start with distinct ObservationView digests and distinct episode ids were used conceptually for the two arms. The current EvaluatorRunMeasurement has no start-observation identity field, and MatchedRecoveryComparison successfully created a pair because it only matches transfer-case, hidden target fixture and action budget plus modes/run ids.
reproduced_claims.inference_boundary: This proves the present contract does not mechanically establish identical public start state across comparison arms. It does not prove any existing benchmark dataset actually used mismatched starts.

reproduced_claims.observation: Two valid WP800 MicroWorldFixture values were constructed with different fixture ids, public digests and holdout_set_id labels but identical evidence_source_family, donor_path_family and method_family. TransferCase accepted them.
reproduced_claims.inference_boundary: This proves current WP805 establishes cross-fixture/cross-holdout identity, not structural-family OOD transfer. It does not invalidate the current bounded cross-fixture component credit.

research_interpretation.incremental_replanning_context: Lifelong Planning A* and D* Lite justify comparing reuse against from-scratch solving specifically for related changed problems, because their claimed benefit comes from reusing prior search information across similar tasks; this increases the importance of exact problem-change and arm-matching identity rather than weakening it.

primary_sources.title: Lifelong Planning A*
primary_sources.authors: Sven Koenig, Maxim Likhachev, David Furcy

research_interpretation.current_world_model_caution: Recent planning/world-model work further motivates explicit coverage/family semantics and local repair cost, but these are research analogies rather than F2 implementation evidence.

preserve: Keep current WP805 generation-1 public/evaluator separation, checkpoint provenance fences, matched target/budget contract and zero-credit boundaries.
Keep current component acceptance bounded to cross-fixture/cross-holdout repository evidence.

new_high_priority_gate.requirement: For any causal recovery-efficiency claim, bind COLD_RESTART and CHECKPOINT_RESUME to one exact evaluator-approved post-change public start identity (observation digest plus episode/generation/step or a sealed start descriptor). The arms may differ in retained planner/checkpoint state, not in observed world start state.

confirmed_later_hardening_gate.requirement: For structural-transfer claims, bind an evaluator-owned transfer-axis/family vector or opaque digest derived from WP800 family metadata and test forbidden overlap. Distinct holdout labels alone remain cross-holdout evidence only.

architecture_delta.still_deferred: Do not require a universal oracle/path-regret authority until WP804 goal/identifiability semantics provide one stable admissible goal contract; when an exact deterministic oracle exists for a specific fixture family, it may be added as evaluator-only optional evidence rather than a second goal authority.
architecture_delta.trace_gate: The preexisting E2 trace-binding gap remains open for stronger repeated-work/replay/runtime-efficiency credit; this E3 run did not reproduce that separate tamper claim.

counterhypothesis.statement: Matching only transfer-case, target hidden fixture and action budget may be enough because test harnesses can externally guarantee identical starts.
counterhypothesis.reason: An external harness guarantee can make a particular experiment valid, but the current persisted MatchedRecoveryComparison receipt cannot prove that guarantee after the fact. Strong causal promotion therefore needs either the start identity in the measurement contract or a bound external start receipt.

next_exact_action: Hand WP805-HARDENING-MATCHED-START-v1 and the already-confirmed structural-split gate to Trigger-4 as a bounded later-generation validation repair. Keep the universal oracle deferred. Separately acquire a new E3 trace-count-tamper claim only if no active worker owns it.
